title: Projecting a compact perturbation onto V does not increase mass (Simon 7.3.1, footnote 2)
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T X S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (RT RX : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), RT.Represents T → RX.Represents X → RT.measure ((V : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ) = 0 → IsCompact X.support → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, S' ω = T ω + RX.action (affinePullbackForm V.starProjection 0 (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m))) → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) = T ω + X ω) ∧ ∀ O : Set (Euclid P), S'.massOn O ≤ R.measure (V.starProjection ⁻¹' O)
